manifest.title_fil: Kilalanin ang panganib sa batang may sakit
objectives_fil: Tukuyin ang danger sign, magpa-agarang referral, at ulitin ang aktuwal na obserbasyon sa handover.
objectives_en: Identify at least one danger sign, activate urgent referral and repeat the observation in a factual handover.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: Sabi ng tagapag-alaga, hindi makainom si Niko, tatlong…
sections.takeaway_en: Case: A caregiver says three-year-old Niko cannot drink and…

sections.takeaway_fil: Tukuyin ang danger sign, magpa-agarang referral, at ulitin ang aktuwal na obserbasyon sa handover.
sections.takeaway_en: Identify at least one danger sign, activate urgent referral and repeat the observation in a factual handover.

sections.takeaway_fil: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.

check.prompt_fil: Sa kasong ito, ano ang unang tugon?
check.prompt_en: In this case, what comes first?

options.fil: Maghintay muna at huwag ipaalam sa staff.
options.en: Wait without notifying the responsible staff.

options.fil: Gawin muna ang shortcut kahit walang kumpirmasyon.
options.en: Use the shortcut before confirming the facts.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong. 2: Maaaring maantala ang kinakailangang assessment. 3: Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag magbigay ng diagnosis, maghintay ng lahat ng senyales, o magpainom sa batang hindi ligtas lumunok.
check.feedback_en: 1: Prioritize safety and timely help. 2: Necessary assessment may be delayed. 3: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not label the illness, wait for every sign, or give anything by mouth to a child who cannot safely swallow.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tukuyin ang danger sign, magpa-agarang referral, at ulitin ang aktuwal na obserbasyon sa handover.
sections.takeaway_en: Identify at least one danger sign, activate urgent referral and repeat the observation in a factual handover.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang saklaw at kailangan sa tamang tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm boundaries and requirements with the appropriate person.

sections.takeaway_fil: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral.
sections.takeaway_en: Observe the task and appropriate referral.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang dapat ipakita sa practice?

options.fil: Ulitin ang shortcut kahit may panganib at walang kumpirmadong tagubilin.
options.en: Repeat the shortcut despite the risk and without confirmed guidance.

options.fil: Magbigay ng diagnosis mula sa kuwento at mangakong sapat na iyon para sa pasyente.
options.en: Diagnose from the story and promise it is enough for the person.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Ang shortcut ay hindi ligtas: Huwag magbigay ng diagnosis, maghintay ng lahat ng senyales, o magpainom sa batang hindi ligtas lumunok. 2: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral. 3: Hindi batayan ang kuwento para sa sariling diagnosis.
check.feedback_en: 1: The shortcut is unsafe: Do not label the illness, wait for every sign, or give anything by mouth to a child who cannot safely swallow. 2: Observe the task and appropriate referral. 3: The story is not grounds for an independent diagnosis.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.
